scope: Present1959 main/small concrete keeps, connecting bridge and attached modern access exterior. Proposed wooden rebuild excluded.

datum.basis: Open dry Honmaru courtyard east of main stone base, south of modern access tower and north of separate Honmaru Palace. This controls courtyard datum, not lower moat or upper stone cap.

ownBridge.basis: Native keeps establish ends; photographed exposed bridge/parapets establish type. Intermediate levels and own thresholds are engineering estimates. Raised own floor.64m to clear preserved independent terrain, without modifying source ground.

smallExteriorStairs.basis: Narrow dogleg stair and rectangular east entry visible in2025 original. Exact tread count, start/end and support engineering approximate; lower flight start raised.06m over original provisional.1m to clear independent ground.

nativePlanInterpretation.mainStoneCap: Retained exact4 native vertices; inferred fan-battered toe extends outward below cap. Root is not a generic solid extruded to keep height.
nativePlanInterpretation.secondMainTier: Repeated lower native outline interpreted as stacked level, inset.45m for own roof/white-wall relationship, not a duplicate whole keep.
nativePlanInterpretation.smallKeep: Distinct native stone-cap quad retained with its own slight rotation; keep body inset, upper ridge runs east/west.
nativePlanInterpretation.access: Distinct attached east modern white tower native footprint retained;2023/2025 original exterior evidence.

limitations: Operator55.6m includes stone wall but its ground/top endpoints are unspecified. It is not used to force independent terrain or claim an exact total from every side.

Native cartography and dated photographs are approximate. Stone batter/toe, window subdivisions, gable profile/details, bridge/floor heights and stair engineering are authored medium-fi interpretations. Gold silhouette is original simplified sculpture.
GSI5A/10m elevation products can retain stone foundations or interpolate hidden ground; centimeter encoding and1m output grid are not survey accuracy. Default coarse Earth ground is not certified.
